# Satvix Tech Solutions

> Satvix Tech Solutions is a digital product and software engineering agency in Anand, Gujarat, India. A small senior team (7+ years MERN experience, founder-led) that builds web platforms, mobile apps and production AI systems for founders and businesses in India, the US, UK, EU and Australia. Eight shipped, verifiable products; AI-augmented delivery with senior review on every change; clients own 100% of the code from day one.

Key facts:
- Location: Anand, Gujarat, India (working across US, UK, EU and Australia time zones; 4+ hours overlap with US East, full working-day overlap with the UK)
- Contact: infosatvixtech@gmail.com · +91 70164 27729 · https://www.satvixtech.com/contact
- Typical pricing: fixed-scope MVPs USD 3,000–12,000; monthly retainers for ongoing product work; staff augmentation for embedded senior engineers
- Typical speed: fintech MVP shipped in 2 weeks; e-commerce in 4 weeks; a Gujarati ledger SaaS in 8 days
- Delivery model: senior engineers only, AI-augmented (Claude Code, Cursor) with senior review on every diff, working demo every Friday, full repository access from day one

## Services

- [AI & ML development](https://www.satvixtech.com/ai-development): LLM features, RAG pipelines, autonomous agents, fine-tuned open-source models (Llama, Mistral, Qwen) — with evaluation harnesses, token cost caps and observability built in
- [Web development](https://www.satvixtech.com/web-development): Next.js, React and Node.js platforms — marketing sites, SaaS dashboards, headless commerce — built to pass Core Web Vitals
- [Mobile app development](https://www.satvixtech.com/mobile-app-development): iOS, Android, React Native and Flutter apps, shipped to the App Store and Play Store with submissions handled
- [UI/UX & product design](https://www.satvixtech.com/ui-ux-design): research, interaction design, design systems, prototyping
- [Graphic design & branding](https://www.satvixtech.com/graphic-design-branding): logo systems, print, social kits, packaging, motion
- [Hire dedicated developers](https://www.satvixtech.com/hire): embedded senior engineers for US/UK/EU teams
- [All services](https://www.satvixtech.com/services)

## Shipped products (case studies)

- [Nine Finance](https://www.satvixtech.com/portfolio/nine-finance): fintech lending platform — borrower and field-agent apps for daily EMI collections (React Native + Node.js, shipped in 2 weeks, live on real loan portfolios)
- [Glamour Jewelry](https://www.satvixtech.com/portfolio/glamour-jewelry): jewelry e-commerce — catalog, orders, inventory, admin (React + Node + MongoDB, 4 weeks, live and processing orders)
- [Charotar Soap Factory](https://www.satvixtech.com/portfolio/charotar-soap): white-label manufacturing SaaS — production batches, stock ledger, sales orders (Next.js + Node.js, licensable)
- [Shreeji HRMS](https://www.satvixtech.com/portfolio/shreeji-hrms): bilingual (Gujarati/Hindi/English) attendance, payroll and ledger app for small business (React Native + Node.js, 3 weeks)
- [Meshwa Traders](https://www.satvixtech.com/portfolio/meshwa-traders): Gujarati-first paddy purchase ledger — farmers, purchases, payments, bardan and labour registers, role-based access (React + Node.js, built in 8 days)
- [D S Power Solution](https://www.satvixtech.com/portfolio/ds-power-solution): local-SEO website for a solar installer in Anand — live at dspowersolution.com
- [Aurevanta Exim](https://www.satvixtech.com/portfolio/aurevanta-exim): B2B website for an Indian spice exporter — live at aurevantaexim.com
- [SK Consultant](https://www.satvixtech.com/portfolio/sk-consultant): services website for an EPFO & HR consultancy — live at sk-consultant.info
